o1: Enables 14-3-3 protein binding activity; beta-catenin binding activity; enzyme binding activity; and DNA-binding transcription factor activity. Predicted to enable transcription factor activity and sequence-specific DNA-binding transcription factor activity. Involved in defense response to other organism, including defense response to bacterium and innate immune response; determination of adult lifespan; dauer larval development; regulation of gene expression; response to starvation; response to heat; response to stress; and insulin receptor signaling pathway. Acts upstream of or within response to oxidative stress. Is located in cytosol and nucleus. Is expressed in germ cell; germ line; gonad; hypodermis; intestine; and neurons. Is part of the insulin receptor signaling pathway; insulin-like growth factor receptor signaling pathway; and insulin-like signaling pathway. Predicted to interact with linc-50. Used to study Parkinson's disease; enterotoxigenic Escherichia coli infection; and Serratia marcescens infection. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma. Orthologous to several human genes including FOXO4 (forkhead box O4). Ameliorates the susceptibility to pathogens phenotype in daf-2(e1370) animals.
